ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure is a wireframe diagram of a transparent cube (die), and a thick black line forms a closed polygonal line; small white dots mark the vertices of the polygonal line, and these vertices are located at the midpoints of the edges of the cube. The thick black polygonal line travels between the faces on the surface of the cube, passes through these edge midpoints, and then returns to the starting point. Reasoning: Following the thick black closed polygonal line in the figure, examine the two incident sides at each edge midpoint point by point. For the midpoint of an edge of the cube, the two polygonal-line sides lie respectively on the two adjacent faces sharing that edge. If the two sides point from this midpoint toward near the same end of this edge, they can be represented by direction vectors such as (0,1,1) and (1,0,1), and the included angle satisfies cos θ = 1/2, so θ = 60°. If the two sides point toward near opposite ends of this edge, they can be represented by direction vectors such as (0,1,1) and (1,0,-1), and the included angle satisfies cos θ = -1/2, so θ = 120°. Classifying around one circuit along the thick line in the figure, one can count 6 angles of 60° and 6 angles of 120°. Therefore the sum of all interior angles is 6×60° + 6×120° = 360° + 720° = 1080°.

raw_record.question_text: In the diagram a closed polygon can be seen whose vertices are the midpoints of the edges of the die. The interior angles are as usual defined as the angle that two sides of the polygon describe in a common vertex. How big is the sum of all interior angles of the polygon?

method.method_draft: Trace the thick black closed polygon in the cube diagram and note that its vertices are the marked midpoints of the cube’s 12 edges. For each marked midpoint, classify the local turn made by the two incident polygon sides. In the cube, two segments joining midpoints of adjacent edges on adjacent faces make either a 60° angle if they head toward the same cube corner, or a 120° angle if they head toward opposite ends of the common cube edge. This can be verified with a unit-cube coordinate dot product: local vectors like (0,1,1) and (1,0,1) give cos=1/2, hence 60°, while (0,1,1) and (1,0,-1) give cos=-1/2, hence 120°. Reading the diagram’s cyclic order gives six 60° turns and six 120° turns, so the total interior-angle sum is 6·60°+6·120°=1080°.

图像描述：附图中是一个透明立方体（骰子）的线框图，粗黑线形成一条闭合折线；白色小圆点标出折线的顶点，这些顶点位于立方体各条棱的中点。粗黑折线在立方体表面各面之间穿行，经过这些棱中点后回到起点。
推理：按图中粗黑闭合折线逐点查看每个棱中点处的两条入射边。对立方体一条棱的中点，两条折线边分别位于共享该棱的两个相邻面上。若两条边从该中点指向这条棱的同一端附近，则可用方向向量如 (0,1,1) 与 (1,0,1) 表示，夹角满足 cos θ = 1/2，所以 θ = 60°。若两条边指向这条棱的相对两端附近，则可用方向向量如 (0,1,1) 与 (1,0,-1) 表示，夹角满足 cos θ = -1/2，所以 θ = 120°。沿图中粗线绕一圈分类，可数到 6 个 60° 角和 6 个 120° 角。因此所有内角之和为 6×60° + 6×120° = 360° + 720° = 1080°。
